cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.description: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.description: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.description: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Farfetch’d
cards.description: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
